title: Performance attribution labels pools and symbols as Persona and offers filters the BFF rejects

delivered: Added SUPPORTED_ATTRIBUTION_DIMENSIONS, UNSUPPORTED_ATTRIBUTION_DIMENSIONS, BFF_ATTRIBUTION_DIMENSION_ALIASES (exact 23 accepted names from services/control-plane/bff/management_read_models/ranking_router.py _PM12_ATTRIBUTION_DIMENSION_ALIASES), BFF_ACCEPTED_ATTRIBUTION_DIMENSIONS, isSupportedAttributionDimension, normalizeSupportedAttributionDimension, isBffAcceptedAttributionDimension, normalizeAttributionDimension, and normalizePerformanceAttributionRow in src/lib/v5/management/performanceAttribution.ts.

Mapped BFF dimension aliases (pool/pools/capitalpool/capitalpools/capital_pools -> capital_pool, asset/assets/instrument/instruments/symbols -> symbol, regime/regimes -> market_regime, personas -> persona, strategies -> strategy, brokers -> broker, runtimes -> runtime) in normalizeAttributionDimension and buildAttributionLinks so pool rows receive capital pool links (/management/governance-decisions?tab=capital&capital_id=...), asset and regime rows receive evidence fallback (/management/evidence) with no persona link, unknown dimensions preserve their raw dimension string and receive no persona link, and explicit links fields from the BFF win when present.

Updated adaptPerformanceAttributionResult and added adaptPerformanceAttributionRows in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts to normalize BFF attribution rows, and guarded mgmt.performanceAttribution.getLiveOnly, listLiveOnly, and list with isBffAcceptedAttributionDimension so unsupported dimensions (asset_class, sector, region, research_backend, quarter) never trigger a 422 BFF transport request.

Updated PerformanceAttributionPage in src/management/pages/oversight/PerformanceAttribution.tsx to use normalizePerformanceAttributionRow, render dimension filter <select> options exclusively from SUPPORTED_ATTRIBUTION_DIMENSIONS (removing asset_class, sector, region, research_backend, and quarter), surface a clear unsupported-dimension notice (data-testid=attribution-unsupported-dimension) when an unsupported dimension query param is requested without issuing a BFF request, render unknown row dimensions as their raw dimension label without falling back to persona, and ensure the persona-focused view and totals count only true persona rows.

Updated bilingual i18n dictionaries in src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts to add mgmt.attribution.unsupportedDimensionNoticeFmt and BFF alias keys (pool, asset, instrument, regime) while removing unsupported 422 dimension keys (asset_class, sector, region, research_backend, quarter).

Added unit and component tests in src/management/pages/oversight/PerformanceAttribution.test.tsx, src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/management-pm12.test.ts, and src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts using the real BFF row shapes and 50-row hosted distribution from the task brief.
not_changed: Preserved ATTRIBUTION_DIMENSIONS 12-item legacy type/array export so existing out-of-scope pm12.test.ts assertions remain green without modification.
Did not weaken, delete, or alter any existing test assertion.
